personal.title: Journal
content:
Had a pretty good week all things considered. Work has been busy but manageable. Finally got round to sorting out the spare room which has been on my list for weeks.

Weather has been miserable but that seems to be the theme lately. Looking forward to spring.

Gym is going well — been consistent this month which makes a change. Trying to get there at least three times a week and mostly managing it.

Need to plan a weekend away at some point. Been ages since I went anywhere properly.

Quiet day today. Made a proper Sunday roast for the first time in months — turned out well actually. Chicken was a bit dry but the roast potatoes were spot on.

Started reading that book James lent me. Good so far. Haven't read properly in ages, keeps getting overtaken by screens.

Meeting with the bank next week about savings. Need to actually do something sensible with money instead of just leaving it in a current account earning nothing.

Back from the weekend trip — was a really good couple of days. Needed to get out of the city for a bit. Nice to see everyone, feels like ages since we've all been in the same place.

Long week ahead. Presentation on Thursday which I need to prepare for properly this time rather than winging it the night before.

Ordered some new trainers online. Probably didn't need them but the old ones were falling apart so I'm calling it a necessity.
